description: Template manifest describing dataset provenance, protocol, and speaker partitioning for SIH26104 Voice Cloning Detection.
notes: Ensure speaker IDs in train, validation, and test splits are strictly non-overlapping to prevent identity leakage.
limitations: Baseline statistical feature extractors (MFCCs) capture acoustic envelopes but may struggle against zero-shot neural diffusion vocoders.
Acoustic room impulse responses or lossy audio codecs (e.g., MP3/AAC) can degrade high-frequency phase indicators.
